description: Use this only when the signed-in owner has clearly said to approve or post one specific post, after they've seen it. It schedules that post to be published on the owner's connected social accounts on its day (or right away if they say now). Publishing can't be undone from here. One post per call; it fails if the post isn't finished or no account is connected.

when.description: its_day (default): its planned day at their usual time. now: right away.

name: approve_post
title: Approve a post
